## Constraints & Failures

- **Constraints**: States use different criteria for establishing cases. Disease management and catastrophic case handling varies by state. Must conform to ACA requirements for EPSDT and immunizations.
- **Potential Failures**: Case details inconsistent with criteria; case discontinued
